Class HLA13CallbackHandler

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.utils.messaging.AbstractMessageHandler
      • org.portico.lrc.LRCMessageHandler
        • org.portico.impl.hla13.handlers.HLA13CallbackHandler
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    IMessageHandler
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    AssumptionRequestCallbackHandler, AttributeOwnershipQueryCallbackHandler, AttributesAcquiredCallbackHandler, AttributesUnavailableCallbackHandler, CancelOwnershipRequestCallbackHandler, DiscoverObjectCallbackHandler, DivestConfirmationCallbackHandler, InitiateSaveCallbackHandler, ProvideUpdateCallbackHandler, ReceiveInteractionCallbackHandler, ReflectAttributesCallbackHandler, RemoveObjectCallbackHandler, RequestAttributeReleaseCallbackHandler, RestoreBegunCallbackHandler, RestoreCompleteCallbackHandler, RestoreInitiateCallbackHandler, RestoreRequestCallbackHandler, SaveCompleteCallbackHandler, SyncAchievedCallbackHandler, SyncAnnounceCallbackHandler, SyncRegResultCallbackHandler, TimeAdvanceGrantCallbackHandler, TimeConstrainedEnabledCallbackHandler, TimeRegulationEnabledCallbackHandler

    public abstract class HLA13CallbackHandler
extends LRCMessageHandler
    This class provides some basic helper methods for dealing with the differences between the standard HLA 1.3 and Java1 interfaces. Callback handlers should extend this class and be sure to call initialize(Map) before they process it for themselves.
